source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Retains the bracketed place-name uncertainty in the pinned Greek.
verses.before: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through God’s will, to the holy ones who are in Ephesus and faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.after: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, to the saints who are [in Ephesus] and faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.tsw_comparator: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the holy ones who are in Ephesus and are faithful in Christ Jesus:

verses.rationale: Keeps the paired greeting and both sources.
verses.before: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.after: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated blessing and heavenly location.
verses.before: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms,
verses.after: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

verses.rationale: Keeps divine choice, time, purpose, and love's possible attachment.
verses.before: just as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless before him in love.
verses.after: For he chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless before him in love.
verses.tsw_comparator: just as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and blameless before him in love,

verses.rationale: Preserves divine purpose and gendered inheritance status.
verses.before: He destined us beforehand for adoption through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.after: He predestined us for adoption as sons through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.tsw_comparator: having predestined us for adoption through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

verses.rationale: Keeps praise, grace wordplay, and Christ's title.
verses.before: to the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely gave us in the Beloved.
verses.after: to the praise of his glorious grace, which he freely bestowed on us in the Beloved.
verses.tsw_comparator: to the praise of the glory of his grace, with which he has graced us in the Beloved.

verses.rationale: Preserves costly release, forgiveness, and abundance.
verses.before: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
verses.after: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of trespasses, according to the wealth of his grace
verses.tsw_comparator: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

verses.rationale: Keeps overflowing grace and its manner/context.
verses.before: which he lavished on us in all wisdom and understanding.
verses.after: that he lavished on us, with all wisdom and understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: which he lavished upon us, in all wisdom and insight,

verses.rationale: Preserves revealed purpose and mystery language.
verses.before: He made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure that he purposed in Christ,
verses.after: He made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure that he purposed in Christ,
verses.tsw_comparator: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure that he set forth in him,

verses.rationale: Keeps timing, administrative image, and cosmic scope.
verses.before: for the administration of the fullness of the times: to bring everything together in Christ, things in heaven and things on earth—in him.
verses.after: for an administration at the fullness of the times: to bring together all things in Christ, things in the heavens and things on earth—in him.
verses.tsw_comparator: for the administration of the fullness of times, to sum up all things in Christ, things in heaven and things on earth.

verses.rationale: Preserves inheritance/passive-lot range and comprehensive purpose.
verses.before: In him we also received an inheritance, having been destined beforehand according to the purpose of the one who works all things according to the counsel of his will,
verses.after: In him we also received an inheritance, having been predestined according to the purpose of the one who works all things according to the counsel of his will,
verses.tsw_comparator: In him we have also been made heirs, having been predestined according to the purpose of the one who works all things according to the counsel of his will,

verses.rationale: Keeps temporal priority and purpose.
verses.before: so that we who first hoped in Christ might be for the praise of his glory.
verses.after: so that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, might live for the praise of his glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that we who first hoped in Christ might be to the praise of his glory.

verses.rationale: Preserves hearing, believing, sealing, and the Spirit's title.
verses.before: In him you also, when you heard the word of truth, the good news of your salvation, and trusted in him, were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
verses.after: In him you also, when you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, and believed in him, were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit.
verses.tsw_comparator: In him you also, when you heard the word of truth, the good news of your salvation, and believed in him, were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

verses.rationale: Keeps pledge, inheritance, possession, and praise.
verses.before: who is the down payment of our inheritance until the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
verses.after: The Spirit is the down payment of our inheritance until the redemption of God's possession, to the praise of his glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: who is the first pledge of our inheritance, until the redemption of the possession, to the praise of his glory.

verses.rationale: Preserves report, faith, and variant-marked love.
verses.before: For this reason, because I have heard about your trust in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the holy ones,
verses.after: For this reason, because I have heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
verses.tsw_comparator: For this reason, because I have heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love toward all the holy ones,

verses.rationale: Keeps continual thanksgiving and remembrance.
verses.before: I do not stop giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,
verses.after: I do not stop giving thanks for you as I remember you in my prayers.
verses.tsw_comparator: I do not cease giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,

verses.rationale: Preserves divine titles and requested knowledge.
verses.before: so that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you a Spirit of wisdom and revelation in knowing him,
verses.after: I pray that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in knowing him.
verses.tsw_comparator: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

verses.rationale: Keeps bodily metaphor, hope, wealth, and communal setting.
verses.before: with the eyes of your heart enlightened, so that you may know the hope of his calling, the riches of the glory of his inheritance among the holy ones,
verses.after: May the eyes of your heart be enlightened so that you may know the hope of his calling, the wealth of his glorious inheritance among the saints,
verses.tsw_comparator: having the eyes of your heart enlightened, so that you may know what is the hope of his calling, what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the holy ones,

verses.rationale: Preserves stacked power terms and believing recipients.
verses.before: and the immeasurable greatness of his power toward us who trust, according to the working of his mighty strength.
verses.after: and the surpassing greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his mighty strength.
verses.tsw_comparator: and what is the surpassing greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his mighty strength,

verses.rationale: Keeps resurrection, enthronement, and location.
verses.before: He worked this power in Christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly realms,
verses.after: God exercised this power in Christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly realms,
verses.tsw_comparator: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly places,

verses.rationale: Preserves complete power list and both ages.
verses.before: far above every ruler, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in the age to come.
verses.after: far above every ruler, authority, power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in the age to come.
verses.tsw_comparator: far above every ruler and authority and power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in the one to come.

verses.rationale: Keeps subjection, body image, and gift to church.
verses.before: He put everything under his feet and gave him as head over everything to the church,
verses.after: He subjected everything under Christ's feet and gave him as head over everything to the church,
verses.tsw_comparator: And he put all things under his feet and gave him as head over all things to the church,

verses.rationale: Preserves dense fullness/filling wordplay.
verses.before: which is his body, the fullness of the one who fills everything in every way.
verses.after: which is his body, the fullness of the one who fills all things in every way.
verses.tsw_comparator: which is his body, the fullness of the one who fills all in all.

verses.rationale: Keeps the unfinished opening and death metaphor.
verses.before: You were dead in your trespasses and sins,
verses.after: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,
verses.tsw_comparator: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,

verses.rationale: Preserves former walk, cosmic ruler, air, and active spirit.
verses.before: in which you once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, the spirit now at work in the children of disobedience.
verses.after: in which you once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit now working in the children of disobedience.
verses.tsw_comparator: in which you once walked, following the course of this age, following the ruler of the authority of the air, the spirit now at work among the children of disobedience.

verses.rationale: Keeps inclusive confession, desires, mind, and wrath idiom.
verses.before: We all once lived among them in the desires of our flesh, doing what the flesh and our thoughts wanted, and we were by nature children of wrath, like the rest.
verses.after: All of us also once lived among them in the desires of our flesh, doing what the flesh and our thoughts willed, and we were by nature children of wrath like the rest.
verses.tsw_comparator: Among them we too once lived, in the desires of our flesh, doing what the flesh and the mind willed; and we were by nature children of wrath, like the rest.

verses.rationale: Preserves divine contrast and love repetition.
verses.before: But God, being rich in mercy, because of the great love with which he loved us,
verses.after: But God, being rich in mercy, because of the great love with which he loved us,
verses.tsw_comparator: But God, being rich in mercy, because of the great love with which he loved us,

verses.rationale: Keeps co-life, interruption, and completed salvation.
verses.before: even when we were dead in trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
verses.after: even when we were dead in trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
verses.tsw_comparator: made us alive together with the Messiah—when we were dead in our trespasses—by grace you have been saved—

verses.rationale: Preserves both co- verbs and location.
verses.before: and raised us up together and seated us together in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
verses.after: and raised us together and seated us together in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
verses.tsw_comparator: and raised us up together with him and seated us together with him in the heavenly places, in the Messiah Jesus,

verses.rationale: Keeps future display, abundance, and kindness.
verses.before: so that in the coming ages he might show the immeasurable riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus.
verses.after: so that in the coming ages he might demonstrate the surpassing wealth of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that in the ages to come he might display the surpassing riches of his grace, in his kindness toward us in the Messiah Jesus.

verses.rationale: Preserves grace, faith, denial of self-source, and gift.
verses.before: For by grace you have been saved through trust, and this is not from yourselves; it is God’s gift,
verses.after: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and this is not from yourselves; it is God's gift,
verses.tsw_comparator: For by grace you have been saved, through faith. And this is not from yourselves; it is the gift of God—

verses.rationale: Keeps the concise exclusion and purpose.
verses.before: not from works, so that no one may boast.
verses.after: not from works, so that no one may boast.
verses.tsw_comparator: not from works, so that no one may boast.

verses.rationale: Preserves creation, prepared works, and walking image.
verses.before: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand so that we might walk in them.
verses.after: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand so that we would walk in them.
verses.tsw_comparator: For we are his making, created in the Messiah Jesus for good works, which God prepared in advance, that we might walk in them.

verses.rationale: Keeps ethnic/bodily labels and their human construction.
verses.before: Therefore remember that formerly you Gentiles in the flesh—called “uncircumcision” by what is called “circumcision,” performed in the flesh by human hands—
verses.after: Therefore remember that formerly you, Gentiles in the flesh—called “uncircumcision” by what is called “circumcision,” performed in the flesh by human hands—
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh—called "the uncircumcision" by what is called "the circumcision," the kind that is done in flesh by hands—

verses.rationale: Preserves the full fivefold estrangement.
verses.before: remember that at that time you were without Christ, excluded from the citizenship of Israel and strangers to the covenants of promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
verses.after: remember that at that time you were without Christ, alienated from the citizenship of Israel and strangers to the covenants of promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
verses.tsw_comparator: that at that time you were apart from the Messiah, alienated from the citizenship of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

verses.rationale: Keeps spatial reversal and costly means.
verses.before: But now in Christ Jesus, you who once were far away have been brought near by the blood of Christ.
verses.after: But now in Christ Jesus, you who once were far away have been brought near by Christ's blood.
verses.tsw_comparator: But now, in the Messiah Jesus, you who once were far off have been brought near in the blood of the Messiah.

verses.rationale: Preserves Christ as peace, two-to-one, wall, body, and hostility.
verses.before: For he himself is our peace, who made both groups one and broke down the dividing wall of hostility in his flesh.
verses.after: For he himself is our peace. He made the two one and in his flesh tore down the dividing wall, the hostility.
verses.tsw_comparator: For he himself is our peace, the one who has made the two one and has broken down the dividing wall of hostility,

verses.rationale: Keeps legal action, creation, two-to-one, and peace.
verses.before: He rendered powerless the Law of commandments in ordinances, so that he might create in himself one new humanity from the two, making peace,
verses.after: He nullified the law of commandments in decrees so that in himself he might create the two into one new humanity, making peace,
verses.tsw_comparator: setting aside in his flesh the law of commandments in decrees, so that in himself he might create the two into one new humanity, making peace,

verses.rationale: Preserves both groups, body, cross, and violent end of hostility.
verses.before: and reconcile both to God in one body through the cross, killing the hostility through it.
verses.after: and reconcile both to God in one body through the cross, killing the hostility through it.
verses.tsw_comparator: and might reconcile both to God in one body through the cross, putting the hostility to death by it.

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated peace and distance groups.
verses.before: He came and announced good news of peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near,
verses.after: He came and proclaimed peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near,
verses.tsw_comparator: And he came and proclaimed the good news of peace to you who were far off and peace to those who were near.

verses.rationale: Preserves mediation, both, unity, and destination.
verses.before: because through him we both have access in one Spirit to the Father.
verses.after: because through him both groups have access in one Spirit to the Father.
verses.tsw_comparator: For through him we both have access in one Spirit to the Father.

verses.rationale: Keeps political and household status reversal.
verses.before: So then you are no longer strangers and resident foreigners, but fellow citizens with the holy ones and members of God’s household,
verses.after: So then, you are no longer strangers and resident foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God's household.
verses.tsw_comparator: So then you are no longer strangers and resident aliens, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and members of the household of God,

verses.rationale: Preserves construction and foundation roles.
verses.before: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the cornerstone.
verses.after: You have been built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the cornerstone.
verses.tsw_comparator: built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with the Messiah Jesus himself as the cornerstone,

verses.rationale: Keeps organic growth and temple image.
verses.before: In him the whole building, joined together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
verses.after: In him the whole building, joined together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
verses.tsw_comparator: in whom the whole building, fitted together, is rising into a holy temple in the Lord;

verses.rationale: Preserves ongoing communal construction and divine dwelling.
verses.before: In him you also are being built together into a dwelling place for God in the Spirit.
verses.after: And in him you also are being built together into a dwelling place for God in the Spirit.
verses.tsw_comparator: in whom you also are being built together into a dwelling for God in the Spirit.

verses.rationale: Keeps interrupted sentence and Paul's re-description of imprisonment.
verses.before: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—
verses.after: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—
verses.tsw_comparator: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—

verses.rationale: Preserves conditional tone, entrusted administration, and recipients.
verses.before: surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace given to me for you,
verses.after: surely you have heard about the stewardship of God's grace that was given to me for you,
verses.tsw_comparator: if indeed you have heard of the stewardship of the grace of God that was given to me for you,

verses.rationale: Keeps revelation, mystery, and prior writing.
verses.before: how the mystery was made known to me by revelation, as I wrote briefly before.
verses.after: that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote briefly before.
verses.tsw_comparator: that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote briefly before,

verses.rationale: Preserves reader access and object of insight.
verses.before: By reading this, you can understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
verses.after: When you read this, you can understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
verses.tsw_comparator: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

verses.rationale: Keeps comparison across generations and present revelation.
verses.before: which was not made known to other generations as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit:
verses.after: which was not made known to people in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to his holy apostles and prophets:
verses.tsw_comparator: which in other generations was not made known to the sons of humanity as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit:

verses.rationale: Preserves three co- compounds and equal participation.
verses.before: the Gentiles are co-heirs, members of the same body, and co-participants in the promise in Christ Jesus through the good news.
verses.after: the Gentiles are coheirs, members of the same body, and copartners in the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel.
verses.tsw_comparator: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, members of the same body, and sharers in the promise in Christ Jesus through the good news.

verses.rationale: Keeps service, gift, grace, and power.
verses.before: I became a servant of this good news according to the gift of God’s grace given to me through the working of his power.
verses.after: I became a servant of this gospel according to the gift of God's grace given to me through the working of his power.
verses.tsw_comparator: Of this I became a servant according to the gift of the grace of God given to me by the working of his power.

verses.rationale: Preserves Paul's intensified self-description and mission.
verses.before: To me, the least of all the holy ones, this grace was given: to announce to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
verses.after: This grace was given to me, the very least of all the saints: to proclaim to the Gentiles the unsearchable wealth of Christ
verses.tsw_comparator: To me, the very least of all the holy ones, this grace was given: to proclaim to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

verses.rationale: Keeps universal disclosure, hidden duration, and Creator.
verses.before: and to bring to light for everyone the administration of the mystery hidden for ages in God, who created all things,
verses.after: and to bring to light for everyone the administration of the mystery hidden for ages in God, who created all things.
verses.tsw_comparator: and to bring to light for all what is the administration of the mystery hidden for ages in God who created all things,

verses.rationale: Preserves church as means, multicolored image, and heavenly powers.
verses.before: so that now, through the church, the many-sided wisdom of God might be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
verses.after: This was so that now, through the church, God's richly varied wisdom might be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
verses.tsw_comparator: so that through the church the manifold wisdom of God might now be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places,

verses.rationale: Keeps purpose's duration and accomplishment.
verses.before: according to the eternal purpose he carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.after: according to the eternal purpose he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.tsw_comparator: according to the eternal purpose that he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord,

verses.rationale: Renders the genitive as Christ's faithfulness and preserves access.
verses.before: In him we have boldness and confident access through trust in him.
verses.after: In him we have boldness and confident access through his faithfulness.
verses.tsw_comparator: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence through faith in him.

verses.rationale: Names affliction and Paul's surprising evaluation.
verses.before: Therefore I ask you not to lose heart because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
verses.after: Therefore I ask you not to lose heart because of my afflictions for you, which are your glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore I ask you not to lose heart over my afflictions for you, which are your glory.

verses.rationale: Keeps bodily prayer posture and resumed phrase.
verses.before: For this reason I bend my knees before the Father,
verses.after: For this reason I bend my knees before the Father,
verses.tsw_comparator: For this reason I bow my knees before the Father,

verses.rationale: Preserves Father/family wordplay and total scope.
verses.before: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
verses.after: from whom every family in heaven and on earth receives its name.
verses.tsw_comparator: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

verses.rationale: Keeps prayer, wealth, Spirit, and inner person.
verses.before: asking that, according to the riches of his glory, he may grant you to be strengthened with power through his Spirit in your inner being,
verses.after: I pray that, according to the wealth of his glory, he may grant you to be strengthened with power through his Spirit in your inner being,
verses.tsw_comparator: that according to the riches of his glory he may grant you to be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

verses.rationale: Preserves dwelling plus agricultural and construction metaphors.
verses.before: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through trust, as you are rooted and grounded in love.
verses.after: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, as you are rooted and grounded in love.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith—being rooted and grounded in love—

verses.rationale: Keeps four dimensions without supplying an unstated object.
verses.before: May you have strength to comprehend, together with all the holy ones, what is the breadth and length and height and depth,
verses.after: May you have strength to grasp, together with all the saints, what is the width and length and height and depth,
verses.tsw_comparator: that you may have strength to comprehend with all the holy ones what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

verses.rationale: Preserves knowledge paradox and fullness.
verses.before: and to know Christ’s love that surpasses knowledge, so that you may be filled to all the fullness of God.
verses.after: and to know Christ's love that surpasses knowledge, so that you may be filled to all the fullness of God.
verses.tsw_comparator: and to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge, so that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

verses.rationale: Keeps extraordinary abundance and active power.
verses.before: Now to the one who is able to do far beyond everything we ask or imagine, according to the power at work within us,
verses.after: Now to the one who is able to do far beyond all that we ask or imagine, according to the power at work within us,
verses.tsw_comparator: Now to the one who is able to do beyond all things exceedingly more than we ask or think, according to the power that is at work in us,

verses.rationale: Preserves both locations of glory and expansive duration.
verses.before: to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus through all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
verses.after: to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus through all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: to him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

verses.rationale: Keeps prisoner identity, exhortation, and calling repetition.
verses.before: Therefore I, the prisoner in the Lord, urge you to walk worthy of the calling with which you were called,
verses.after: Therefore I, the prisoner in the Lord, urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling with which you were called,
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore I, the prisoner in the Lord, urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling to which you have been called,

verses.rationale: Preserves the four relational qualities.
verses.before: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
verses.after: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
verses.tsw_comparator: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

verses.rationale: Keeps Spirit as unity's source and peace as bond.
verses.before: making every effort to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace:
verses.after: making every effort to preserve the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace:
verses.tsw_comparator: being eager to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated one and calling.
verses.before: one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope of your calling;
verses.after: one body and one Spirit, just as you were also called in one hope of your calling;
verses.tsw_comparator: There is one body and one Spirit, just as also you were called in one hope of your calling,

verses.rationale: Keeps the terse threefold confession.
verses.before: one Lord, one trust, one baptism;
verses.after: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
verses.tsw_comparator: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated all and three relations.
verses.before: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
verses.after: one God and Father of all, who is over all, through all, and in all.
verses.tsw_comparator: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.

verses.rationale: Keeps movement from unity to individual gift and measured grace.
verses.before: But grace was given to each one of us according to the measure of Christ’s gift.
verses.after: But grace was given to each one of us according to the measure of Christ's gift.
verses.tsw_comparator: But to each one of us grace was given according to the measure of Christ’s gift.

verses.rationale: Retains unusual captive-captivity wording and gift shift.
verses.before: Therefore it says, “When he ascended on high, he took captivity captive and gave gifts to people.”
verses.after: Therefore it says, “When he ascended on high, he took captivity captive; he gave gifts to people.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore it says, “When he ascended on high he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to human beings.”

verses.rationale: Keeps interpretive question and geographic ambiguity.
verses.before: Now what does “he ascended” mean except that he also descended into the lower regions of the earth?
verses.after: Now what does “he ascended” mean except that he also descended into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.tsw_comparator: Now this expression, “he ascended,” what does it mean except that he also descended into the lower parts of the earth?

verses.rationale: Preserves same subject, movement, and purpose.
verses.before: The one who descended is the same one who also ascended far above all the heavens so that he might fill all things.
verses.after: The one who descended is also the one who ascended far above all the heavens, so that he might fill all things.
verses.tsw_comparator: The one who descended is the same one who also ascended far above all the heavens, so that he might fill all things.

verses.rationale: Keeps persons as gifts and the five designations.
verses.before: And he himself gave some as apostles, some as prophets, some as evangelists, and some as shepherds and teachers,
verses.after: And he himself gave some as apostles, some as prophets, some as evangelists, and some as pastors and teachers,
verses.tsw_comparator: And he gave some as apostles, some as prophets, some as evangelists, some as shepherds and teachers,

verses.rationale: Preserves equipping, saints' ministry, and bodily construction.
verses.before: to equip the holy ones for the work of ministry, for building up Christ’s body,
verses.after: to equip the saints for the work of ministry, for building up Christ's body,
verses.tsw_comparator: for the equipping of the holy ones for the work of ministry, for the building up of the body of Christ,

verses.rationale: Keeps communal goal and adult/fullness measure.
verses.before: until we all reach unity of the trust and of the knowledge of God’s Son, mature humanity, the measure of the stature of Christ’s fullness.
verses.after: until all of us reach unity in the faith and in knowing the Son of God, mature humanity, the measure of the stature of Christ's fullness.
verses.tsw_comparator: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to maturity, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

verses.rationale: Preserves sea/weather images and intentional deception.
verses.before: Then we will no longer be children, tossed by waves and carried around by every wind of teaching, by human trickery and crafty schemes of deceit.
verses.after: Then we will no longer be children, tossed by waves and carried around by every wind of teaching, by human trickery and cunning schemes that lead into error.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth by the waves and carried about by every wind of teaching, by human cunning, by craftiness in deceitful schemes;

verses.rationale: Keeps truth-as-action, love, growth, and head image.
verses.before: Instead, speaking truth in love, let us grow in every way into him who is the head—Christ.
verses.after: Instead, speaking truth in love, let us grow in every way into him who is the head—Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: but speaking the truth in love, we are to grow up in every way into him who is the head, Christ,

verses.rationale: Preserves integrated body and each part's measured action.
verses.before: From him the whole body, joined and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love as each part does its work.
verses.after: From him the whole body, joined and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love as each individual part does its work in proper measure.
verses.tsw_comparator: from whom the whole body, joined and held together by every supporting joint, according to the working of each individual part, makes the body grow so that it builds itself up in love.

verses.rationale: Keeps solemn charge and walk/mind relation.
verses.before: Therefore I say this and testify in the Lord: you must no longer walk as the Gentiles walk, in the futility of their thinking.
verses.after: Therefore I say this and testify in the Lord: you must no longer walk as the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their minds.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore I say this and testify in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles walk, in the futility of their minds,

verses.rationale: Preserves mental, relational, causal, and bodily imagery.
verses.before: They are darkened in understanding, alienated from God’s life because of the ignorance in them, because of the hardness of their hearts.
verses.after: They are darkened in understanding and alienated from God's life because of the ignorance within them, because of the hardness of their hearts.
verses.tsw_comparator: being darkened in understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, due to the hardness of their hearts;

verses.rationale: Keeps self-surrender, practice, and acquisitive excess.
verses.before: Having become callous, they gave themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity with greed.
verses.after: Having become callous, they gave themselves over to debauchery, to practice every kind of impurity with greed.
verses.tsw_comparator: who, having become callous, have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity with greed.

verses.rationale: Retains Christ as the person learned and the interrupted thought.
verses.before: But that is not how you learned Christ—
verses.after: But that is not how you learned Christ,
verses.tsw_comparator: But you did not learn Christ in this way—

verses.rationale: Keeps conditional force, direct hearing, and truth relation.
verses.before: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, as truth is in Jesus:
verses.after: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, just as truth is in Jesus:
verses.tsw_comparator: if indeed you have heard him and were taught in him, just as truth is in Jesus—

verses.rationale: Preserves clothing metaphor, former conduct, and continuing corruption.
verses.before: put off the old humanity, which belongs to your former way of life and is being corrupted through deceitful desires;
verses.after: you were taught to put off the old person belonging to your former way of life, which is being corrupted by deceitful desires,
verses.tsw_comparator: to put off your former way of life, the old self, which is being corrupted according to deceitful desires,

verses.rationale: Keeps passive renewal and mental sphere.
verses.before: be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
verses.after: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds,
verses.tsw_comparator: and to be renewed in the spirit of your minds,

verses.rationale: Preserves clothing, creation, divine pattern, and truth.
verses.before: and put on the new humanity, created according to God in righteousness and holiness of truth.
verses.after: and to put on the new person, created according to God in the righteousness and holiness that come from truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: and to put on the new self, created according to God in righteousness and holiness of truth.

verses.rationale: Keeps quotation and bodily reason for truthfulness.
verses.before: Therefore, putting away falsehood, “let each of you speak truth with your neighbor,” because we are members of one another.
verses.after: Therefore, putting away falsehood, “each of you speak truth with your neighbor,” because we are members of one another.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore, having put away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

verses.rationale: Preserves command, limit, sun image, and ongoing irritation.
verses.before: “Be angry and do not sin.” Do not let the sun go down on your anger,
verses.after: “Be angry, but do not sin.” Do not let the sun set while you remain provoked,
verses.tsw_comparator: Be angry and do not sin; do not let the sun set on your anger,

verses.rationale: Keeps the spatial opportunity metaphor.
verses.before: and do not give the devil an opportunity.
verses.after: and do not give the devil an opportunity.
verses.tsw_comparator: and do not give place to the devil.

verses.rationale: Preserves cessation, work, bodily means, and generosity's purpose.
verses.before: The one who steals must steal no longer; instead, let that person work, doing good with their own hands so they may have something to share with anyone in need.
verses.after: The one who steals must steal no longer, but rather must labor, doing good work with their own hands, so that they may have something to share with anyone in need.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the one who steals steal no longer, but rather let him labor, doing honest work with his own hands, so that he may have something to share with the one who has need.

verses.rationale: Keeps decay image, situational benefit, and grace.
verses.before: Let no corrupt word come out of your mouth, but only what is good for building up as the need requires, so that it may give grace to those who hear.
verses.after: Let no rotten word come out of your mouth, but only what is good for building up as the need requires, so that it may give grace to those who hear.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let no corrupt word come out of your mouth, but only what is good for building up, as fits the need, so that it may give grace to those who hear.

verses.rationale: Preserves personal grief, seal, and future day.
verses.before: And do not grieve God’s Holy Spirit, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.after: And do not grieve God's Holy Spirit, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.tsw_comparator: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

verses.rationale: Keeps the complete harmful-speech/anger list.
verses.before: Let all bitterness, rage, anger, shouting, and slander be removed from you, along with every kind of malice.
verses.after: Let all bitterness, rage, anger, shouting, and slander be removed from you, along with every kind of malice.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let all bitterness and wrath and anger and shouting and slander be removed from you, along with all malice.

verses.rationale: Preserves mutuality and divine pattern.
verses.before: Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, just as God in Christ also forgave you.
verses.after: Instead, be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other just as God in Christ forgave you.
verses.tsw_comparator: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, just as God in Christ forgave you.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine imitation grounded in beloved kinship.
verses.before: Therefore imitate God as beloved children,
verses.after: Therefore imitate God, as dearly loved children,
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children,

verses.rationale: Preserves self-giving, cultic terms, and fragrance image.
verses.before: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself for us, an offering and sacrifice to God as a fragrant aroma.
verses.after: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself for us as an offering and sacrifice to God, a fragrant aroma.
verses.tsw_comparator: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.

verses.rationale: Keeps broad categories and community standard.
verses.before: But sexual immorality and every kind of impurity or greed must not even be named among you, as is fitting for holy people,
verses.after: But sexual immorality, every kind of impurity, or greed must not even be named among you, as is fitting for saints.
verses.tsw_comparator: But sexual immorality and all impurity or greed must not even be named among you, as is fitting for holy ones.

verses.rationale: Preserves speech contrasts and thanksgiving wordplay.
verses.before: nor obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of place, but rather thanksgiving.
verses.after: Nor should there be shameful behavior, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are improper, but rather thanksgiving.
verses.tsw_comparator: Obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking—things that are out of place—must not be found among you; instead, there is thanksgiving.

verses.rationale: Keeps vice identities, greed/idolatry relation, and inheritance.
verses.before: For know this clearly: no sexually immoral, impure, or greedy person—who is an idolater—has an inheritance in Christ’s and God’s kingdom.
verses.after: For know this with certainty: no sexually immoral, impure, or greedy person—who is an idolater—has an inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you may be sure of this: everyone who is sexually immoral or impure, or who is greedy (that is, an idolater), has no inheritance in the reign of Christ and of God.

verses.rationale: Preserves warning, cause, wrath, and kinship idiom.
verses.before: Let no one deceive you with empty words, because because of these things God’s wrath comes on the children of disobedience.
verses.after: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things God's wrath comes upon the children of disobedience.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the children of disobedience.

verses.rationale: Keeps partnership prohibition concise.
verses.before: Therefore do not become partners with them.
verses.after: Therefore do not become partners with them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore do not become partners with them.

verses.rationale: Preserves identity contrast and movement command.
verses.before: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light—
verses.after: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light—
verses.tsw_comparator: For once you were darkness, but now in the Lord you are light. Walk as children of light—

verses.rationale: Keeps light-fruit metaphor and three qualities.
verses.before: for the fruit of the light consists in every kind of goodness, righteousness, and truth—
verses.after: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth—
verses.tsw_comparator: for the fruit of the light is found in all that is good and right and true—

verses.rationale: Preserves active discernment linked to walking.
verses.before: testing what is pleasing to the Lord.
verses.after: testing what is pleasing to the Lord.
verses.tsw_comparator: and try to discern what is pleasing to the Lord.

verses.rationale: Keeps participation/exposure contrast.
verses.before: Do not participate in the fruitless works of darkness; instead, expose them.
verses.after: Do not participate in the fruitless works of darkness, but instead expose them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Take no part in the unfruitful works of darkness, but instead expose them.

verses.rationale: Preserves secrecy and speech restraint.
verses.before: For it is shameful even to speak about the things they do in secret.
verses.after: For it is shameful even to speak of the things they do in secret.
verses.tsw_comparator: For it is shameful even to mention what such people do in secret.

verses.rationale: Keeps exposure and manifestation.
verses.before: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible,
verses.after: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible,
verses.tsw_comparator: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible,

verses.rationale: Preserves difficult light claim and poetic summons.
verses.before: for everything made visible is light. Therefore it says, “Wake up, sleeper, and rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
verses.after: for everything made visible is light. Therefore it says, “Wake up, sleeper, and rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
verses.tsw_comparator: for everything that becomes visible is light. Therefore it says, “Awake, sleeper, and rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

verses.rationale: Keeps exact attention, movement image, and contrast.
verses.before: Therefore watch carefully how you walk—not as unwise people but as wise,
verses.after: Therefore watch carefully how you walk—not as unwise people but as wise,
verses.tsw_comparator: Be careful, then, how you live—not as unwise but as wise,

verses.rationale: Retains commercial time image and moral reason.
verses.before: making the most of the time, because the days are evil.
verses.after: buying up the opportunity, because the days are evil.
verses.tsw_comparator: making the most of the time, because the days are evil.

verses.rationale: Keeps wisdom contrast and object.
verses.before: For this reason do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
verses.after: Because of this, do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord's will is.
verses.tsw_comparator: So do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

verses.rationale: Preserves intoxication/consequence and Spirit contrast.
verses.before: Do not get drunk with wine, which leads to reckless living, but be filled with the Spirit,
verses.after: Do not get drunk with wine, which leads to reckless living, but be filled by the Spirit,
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not get drunk with wine, for that is debauchery; but be filled with the Spirit,

verses.rationale: Keeps mutual speech, three song forms, and inward music.
verses.before: speaking to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing and making music in your heart to the Lord,
verses.after: speaking to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing and making melody to the Lord with your heart,
verses.tsw_comparator: speaking to one another with psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody to the Lord in your hearts,

verses.rationale: Preserves both comprehensive terms and divine relations.
verses.before: giving thanks always for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.after: always giving thanks for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.tsw_comparator: giving thanks always and for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.rationale: Keeps mutual submission as the participial frame.
verses.before: submitting to one another in reverence for Christ.
verses.after: submitting to one another in reverence for Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ.

verses.rationale: Supplies the verb from the immediately preceding mutual-submission clause.
verses.before: Wives, submit to your own husbands as to the Lord,
verses.after: Wives, submit to your own husbands as to the Lord,
verses.tsw_comparator: Wives, to your husbands as to the Lord.

verses.rationale: Preserves husband/wife specificity and head/body comparison.
verses.before: because the husband is head of the wife as Christ also is head of the church—he himself being Savior of the body.
verses.after: because a husband is head of his wife as Christ is head of the church, he himself the Savior of the body.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the husband is the head of the wife just as Christ is the head of the church—the body of which he is the Savior.

verses.rationale: Keeps the comparison and comprehensive wording.
verses.before: But as the church submits to Christ, so wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
verses.after: But as the church submits to Christ, so wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
verses.tsw_comparator: Just as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit in everything to their husbands.

verses.rationale: Preserves direct gendered command and self-giving standard.
verses.before: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself for her,
verses.after: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself for her,
verses.tsw_comparator: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her,

verses.rationale: Keeps sanctifying purpose, feminine church, washing, and word.
verses.before: so that he might make her holy, cleansing her with the washing of water by the word,
verses.after: so that he might make her holy, cleansing her by the washing of water with the word,
verses.tsw_comparator: in order to make her holy, cleansing her by the washing of water with the word,

verses.rationale: Preserves presentation, bodily images, and ethical purpose.
verses.before: so that he might present the church to himself in splendor, without spot or wrinkle or anything like that, but holy and blameless.
verses.after: so that he might present the church to himself in splendor, without spot or wrinkle or anything like that, but holy and blameless.
verses.tsw_comparator: so as to present the church to himself in splendor, without spot or wrinkle or anything of the kind—yes, so that she may be holy and without blemish.

verses.rationale: Keeps bodily identity and male specificity.
verses.before: In the same way husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. The one who loves his wife loves himself.
verses.after: In the same way, husbands ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. The man who loves his own wife loves himself,
verses.tsw_comparator: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

verses.rationale: Preserves nourishment and tender bodily care.
verses.before: For no one ever hated their own flesh, but nourishes and cares for it, just as Christ does the church,
verses.after: for no one ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and tenderly cares for it, just as Christ does the church,
verses.tsw_comparator: For no one ever hates one’s own body, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church,

verses.rationale: Keeps corporate bodily relation.
verses.before: because we are members of his body.
verses.after: because we are members of his body.
verses.tsw_comparator: because we are members of his body.

verses.rationale: Preserves gender, movement, union, and quotation.
verses.before: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
verses.after: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh.”

verses.rationale: Keeps magnitude and stated referent.
verses.before: This mystery is great, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
verses.after: This mystery is great, and I am speaking about Christ and the church.
verses.tsw_comparator: This mystery is great, and I am speaking with reference to Christ and the church.

verses.rationale: Preserves differentiated closing commands; respect renders relational fear.
verses.before: Nevertheless, each one of you must love his own wife as himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
verses.after: Nevertheless, each one of you must love his own wife as himself, and the wife should respect her husband.
verses.tsw_comparator: Each of you, however, should love his wife as himself, and a wife should respect her husband.
